app.name: 字幕工厂
app.subtitle: 本地转写与 AI 双语字幕工具

localization.description:
字幕工厂（简洁版）是一款为 Apple Silicon Mac 打造的本地优先字幕工具，将本地视频导入、离线语音转写、按需 AI 整理与翻译、SRT 导出集中在清爽的单页界面中。

本地转写优先
• 音频与字幕默认完全在你的 Mac 本机处理，音频文件不会上传到云端。
• 支持 App 管理的 Whisper、Parakeet、Qwen3-ASR 等本地语音识别模型，并可按模型选择 CPU、Apple GPU 或 Core ML 运行设备。
• 本地处理失败不会静默上传，也不会自动切换到云端服务。

简洁高效流程
• 导入本地视频后一键完成音频提取、离线转写、可选 AI 整理与翻译。
• 在单页视图中实时查看转写进度与字幕列表，支持随时停止任务。
• 通过 macOS 原生保存面板一键导出原文、译文或双语 SRT 字幕。

按需 AI 文本增强
• 可自行配置兼容 OpenAI 接口的文本服务，用于整理断句标点与字幕翻译。
• AI 文本请求只在用户填写 API Key 并明确启用后执行，仅发送当前任务的字幕文本。

Mac App Store 版启用 App Sandbox，只处理用户主动选择的本地视频，不提供第三方网站下载、浏览器 Cookie 或外部运行时路径。核心本地导入、离线转写与 SRT 导出无需任何第三方账号。

review.notes:
No account is required. The app opens directly on a single-page subtitle generation workspace.

To test the complete local workflow:
1. Select a local MP4 that the reviewer is authorized to use.
2. Choose a local speech recognition model and start transcription to view progress and generated subtitles.
3. Export the resulting SRT subtitle file via the native macOS save panel. Local import, transcription, and SRT export work without any third-party API key.

The Mac App Store build intentionally removes YouTube downloading, browser-cookie access, and external runtime/model paths. These entries are absent from the UI and are also blocked by the backend distribution policy.

AI subtitle cleanup and translation are optional text-only features that run only after the user configures a provider API key and explicitly enables them. Audio is always processed locally on-device, and the app never silently falls back from local processing to cloud processing. Dedicated review credentials, if requested, must be supplied only through App Review Notes and must not be embedded in the app or public repository.
